description: Run a long session as a foreman: size the task, pick a delegation architecture, and dispatch scoped slices to model-tiered agents (scout, builder, reviewer, lead). Skills cover orchestration, session handoff, backlog waves, and a review cycle (rubric-panel, deletion-pass, layer-cycle). Hooks watch context watermarks, guard handoff freshness, surface the handoff on cold start, and log delegation tier usage.
name: foreman-kit
